As a Co-VP, I want Home to be impossible to delete or unpublish, so that the site always has a front page.\n42. As a Co-VP, I want to change the Study Hall time or room in one place, so that it is never out of date in a second file.\n43. As a Co-VP, I want a Go live button, so that I can update the public site without a terminal.\n44. As a Co-VP, I want the dashboard to show when the last Go live was, so that I know how current the public site is.\n45. As a Co-VP, I want a warning with the number of changes that are Not live yet, so that a Published reminder is never left unseen.\n46. As a Co-VP, I want a plain error if Go live fails, so that I know the public site did not change.\n47. As a Co-VP, I want Editors not to have the Go live button, so that going public stays with us.\n48. As a Co-VP, I want to see every Account with its Position, Role, and whether it is Deactivated, so that I know who can sign in.\n49. As a Co-VP, I want to create an Account for a new Position and choose its Role, so that a new Officer job can post.\n50. As a Co-VP, I want to change an Account's Role, so that a Position's permissions can change.\n51. As a Co-VP, I want to set a new password for any Account, so that a forgotten password or a Handover is a one-minute fix.\n52. As a Co-VP, I want to deactivate the Account of a vacant Position, so that it cannot sign in.\n53. As a Co-VP, I want to reactivate an Account, so that a Position that returns can post again.\n54. As a Co-VP, I want a Deactivated Account's Posts to stay on the site, so that history is not lost.\n55. As a Co-VP, I want the console to refuse to deactivate or demote the last active Admin, so that we cannot lock ourselves out.\n\n### Everyone in the console\n\n56. As an Officer, I want a dashboard with counts of Draft Posts, Published Posts, and Pages, so that I see the state of the site at a glance.\n57. As an Officer, I want one content list of Posts and Pages, newest first, so that I can find anything.\n58. As an Officer, I want to filter that list by Draft/Published and by Post/Page, so that I can find last week's reminder quickly.\n59. As an Officer, I want the list to show each Post's Author as a Position, so that I know which Position wrote it.\n60. As an Officer, I want the same navigation on every console screen, so that I never get lost.\n61. As an Officer on a phone-width window, I want console screens not to scroll sideways, so that they stay usable.\n\n### Running and grading\n\n62. As the developer, I want a seed command that creates the demo Accounts, the three Pages, and a few Posts (at least one Draft, one Published), so that the CMS can be used immediately from a clean clone.\n63. As the developer, I want `cms publish` and `cms deploy` to keep working from the terminal, so that the documented commands still work alongside the button.\n\n## Implementation Decisions\n\n### Modules\n\n- **Accounts and sessions.** Verifies a sign-in, hashes passwords with argon2, keeps the session in a signed cookie that ends when the browser closes, and exposes one guard for \"must be signed in\" and one for \"must be Admin\". All permission checks go through these guards, never through hidden links alone.\n- **Content.** One module that owns Posts and Pages: saving, status changes, Link generation, deletion, and the rules about who may do what. Routes ask it; they do not decide permissions themselves.\n- **Markdown rendering.** One function turns a Markdown body into sanitized HTML. The editor preview, the local public preview, and the export all call this same function, so nothing can be rendered unsanitized.\n- **Site export.** The existing export function is extended to write the whole public site from Published rows only.\n- **Go live.** Runs the export, pushes the result, and records the time. It is called by the dashboard button and by the `cms deploy` command.\n- **Admin console.** Dashboard, content list, editor, Accounts screen, sign-in screen. Server-rendered templates, no JavaScript framework (ADR-002).\n- **Seed script.** Extended to create demo Accounts, Pages, and Posts.\n\n### Data\n\n- **Account:** sign-in email (unique), display name (the Position, e.g. \"Social Chair\"), password hash, Role (`admin` or `editor`), active flag, created time.\n- **Post:** title, Link (unique among Posts), Markdown body, status (`draft` or `published`), Author (an Account), created time, updated time, first-published time.\n- **Page:** the same fields, plus a marker for which Page is Home.\n- **Site state:** the time of the last Go live, and a count of changes that are Not live yet.\n- Storage is SQLite (ADR-002). The database file is never committed.\n\n### Rules\n\n- **Roles.** Editors: create, edit, publish, unpublish, and delete any Post; edit the body of any existing Page. Admins: everything Editors can do, plus create and delete Pages, change a Page's title and status, manage Accounts, and Go live.\n- **Home.** Created automatically if missing. Cannot be deleted or set to Draft by anyone. Its body holds the standing Study Hall time and place.\n- **Links.** A Post's Link is the date plus a URL-safe form of the title (for example `2026-10-05-study-hall-tonight`). If that Link already exists, a number is added. A Page's Link is the URL-safe form of its title. A Link is set when the item is first Published and never changes after that, even if the title changes or the item goes back to Draft and is Published again. Officers never type a Link.\n- **Dates.** A Post's public date is its first-published time, shown with the weekday. Dates are shown in US Eastern time.\n- **Deleting.** Deleting a Post or Page is permanent and always goes through a confirmation screen. There is no trash.\n- **Accounts.** Accounts are deactivated, never deleted. A Deactivated Account cannot sign in, and an existing session for it stops working. The last active Admin cannot be deactivated or changed to Editor.\n- **Passwords.** Only an Admin sets a password, from the Accounts screen. No password is ever logged or shown.\n- **Not live yet.** Any change that would alter the public site adds one to the count: publishing or unpublishing, editing or deleting something Published. Edits to Drafts do not count. Go live resets the count to zero.\n- **Go live.** Admin only. If the push fails, the console shows a plain error, and the count and last Go live time are left as they were.\n\n### Contracts\n\n- Sign-in is a form posted to `/login` with fields `email` and `password`, matching the template's test helper. The console lives under `/admin`.\n- Every state-changing request is a POST carrying a CSRF token, including sign-out, delete, and Go live. A POST without a valid token is rejected.\n- An anonymous request to any console screen redirects to sign-in. A signed-in Editor requesting an Admin-only screen gets a 403 \"no permission\" screen.\n- Wrong email and wrong password give the same message.\n- `/` on the local app is a preview of the public site and shows Published content only.\n\n### Public site layout\n\n- Home at the site root; one file per other Published Page; one file per Published Post in a posts folder; a Past posts list in that folder; one stylesheet.\n- Navigation: Home first, then the other Published Pages in the order they were created, which gives Home, About, Join & Snacks. Past posts is linked from Home, not from the navigation.\n- Home shows its own body, then the latest Published Post in full. Past posts lists the older Published Posts, newest first.\n- Every `href` and `src` is relative. Files in the posts folder reach the stylesheet and the Pages with `../`.\n- No Author is shown publicly.\n- Raw HTML typed into a body is not passed through, and the rendered HTML is sanitized with an allowlist. Images are not in the allowlist.\n\n### Demo data\n\n- The seed creates four Accounts: Co-VP (Admin), and Co-President, Social Chair, and Treasurer (Editors). The Co-VP signs in as `admin@example.test` and the Social Chair as `editor@example.test`, matching the template's test helper; the other two use `copresident@example.test` and `treasurer@example.test`.\n- Passwords come from the environment. All three Editor Accounts use the one Editor demo password.\n- The seed creates Home, About, and Join & Snacks as Published Pages, and at least one Published and one Draft Post.\n\n### Screens\n\n- Every console screen has the same navigation and shows a success or error message after each action.\n- The editor has a formatting hint under the body box (bold, link) and a Preview button that shows the sanitized rendering.\n- Once a Post is live, the editor shows its full public address, built from the configured public site address.\n- No horizontal scrolling at 390 px on the public Home page or the console screens.\n\n## Testing Decisions\n\nA good test here drives the app the way an Officer or Visitor does and checks what they would see: a status code, a redirect, text on a screen, or a file in the exported site. Tests do not reach into the database or call internal functions to check how something was stored.\n\n### Seams\n\nThere are two seams, and both already exist in the template.\n\n1. **The console over HTTP.** Tests use the existing `client` and `client_as(\"admin\" | \"editor\")` fixtures to request screens and post forms. This covers sign-in, Roles, Posts, Pages, the dashboard, the content list, preview, Accounts, CSRF, and Go live.\n2. **The exported site.** Tests call the export into a temporary folder and read the files it wrote. This covers Published-only content, navigation, relative paths, sanitizing, dates, and Links.\n\nOne thing is replaced in tests: the push to GitHub inside Go live. Tests swap it for a fake that records it was called (or fails on purpose), so no test ever pushes to the real repository.\n\nEach test runs against its own temporary database seeded with the demo Accounts, so the fixed test passwords in the fixtures work.\n\n### What gets tested\n\n- Every row of `SECURITY-CHECKLIST.md` has at least one test.\n- Each Role rule has a test for the allowed case and the refused case, requested by direct URL rather than by clicking.\n- Draft content never appears in the export, the local preview, or the Past posts list.\n- A body containing `<script>` and an `onerror=` attribute is harmless in both the preview and the export.\n- Link rules: same-title collision, frozen after Published.\n- Last-Admin protection, Home protection, Deactivated sign-in refusal.\n- Not live yet count goes up on public-affecting changes and resets on Go live; a failed push leaves it unchanged.\n\n### Prior art\n\n`tests/test_t00.py` already uses both seams. Its four tests are kept. One must change when sign-in lands: it currently expects an anonymous request to `/admin` to return the \"hello admin\" page, which contradicts the rule that anonymous Visitors are redirected to sign-in. It becomes two assertions: anonymous is redirected, and a signed-in Officer sees the dashboard.\n\n## Out of Scope\n\n- Sending the Weekly email. It stays manual; the CMS only supplies the Link.\n- Hosting the snack request form. Join & Snacks links to the Google Form.\n- Scheduled Posts or a calendar.\n- Comments, or any Visitor sign-in.\n- Image uploads, including Officer photos on About, and images linked from other sites. A console upload for Pages with alt text may be added later as a separate `stretch` issue, only after all seven capabilities work.\n- Categories, tags, and search.\n- A trash bin or undo for deleted Posts.\n- \"Forgot my password\" emails.\n- A \"copy last week's reminder\" button. This is the first future improvement.\n- One Account per person (see ADR-003).\n- Putting the console on the internet (see ADR-001).\n- Multi-site, drag-and-drop page builders, and rich-text editors (excluded by the assignment).\n\n## Further Notes\n\n- Stage 2 is due Tuesday Oct 6, 2:40 pm, with grace to Wednesday Oct 7, 2:40 pm. Tickets should be ordered so sign-in, Posts, and the export land first.\n- The Monday routine this spec is built around: an Officer writes the Study Hall reminder, marks it Published, a Co-VP presses Go live, and the Officer sends the Weekly email with the Link.\n- \"Publish\" means two different things in everyday speech. In this project, **Published** is a status and **Go live** is the step that reaches Visitors. The `cms publish` command keeps its name because the assignment fixes it; it is the export half of Go live.\n- The Accounts screen is what the assignment calls \"user management\". Keep this file small.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import FastAPI, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, Response\nfrom starlette.middleware.sessions import SessionMiddleware\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, publish, settings\nfrom app.routes import auth, pages, posts\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n\ndef create_app() -> FastAPI:\n    accounts.init_db()\n    content.init_db()\n    app = FastAPI(title=\"IPHS 400 MP2 CMS\")\n    # max_age=None: a session cookie with no Expires/Max-Age, so it ends when the\n    # browser closes.\n    app.add_middleware(SessionMiddleware, secret_key=settings.SECRET_KEY,\n                       session_cookie=\"session\", max_age=None,\n                       same_site=\"lax\", https_only=False)\n    app.include_router(auth.router)\n    app.include_router(posts.router)\n    app.include_router(pages.router)\n\n    @app.exception_handler(accounts.NoPermission)\n    def no_permission(request: Request, exc: accounts.NoPermission):\n        return templates.TemplateResponse(\n            request, \"admin/no_permission.html\",\n            {\"title\": \"No permission\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\"}, status_code=403)\n\n    # The local preview of the public site: the same renderers the export uses,\n    # at the same relative paths, so it shows Published content only.\n    @app.get(\"/\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_home():\n        return publish.render_front()\n\n    @app.get(\"/style.css\")\n    def public_css():\n        return Response(publish.CSS, media_type=\"text/css\")\n\n    @app.get(\"/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_page(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_page(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n        return page\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_past():\n        return publish.render_past()\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_post(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_post(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n        return page\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Content: Posts and Pages.\n\nOwns saving, status changes, Link generation, and deletion. Routes ask this\nmodule; they do not touch the database themselves. Any Editor or Admin may do\nanything to any Post, so there are no per-Post permission checks here. Pages\ndiffer: only an Admin changes a Page's title, and Home is protected for everyone.\n\nTimes are stored as UTC ISO strings and shown in US Eastern.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfo\n\nfrom app.accounts import connect\n\nEASTERN = ZoneInfo(\"America/New_York\")\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\ncreate table if not exists posts (\n    id integer primary key,\n    title text not null,\n    link text not null unique,\n    body text not null default '',\n    status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id integer not null references accounts(id),\n    created_at text not null,\n    updated_at text not null,\n    first_published_at text\n)\n\"\"\"\n\nPAGE_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\ncreate table if not exists pages (\n    id integer primary key,\n    title text not null,\n    link text not null unique,\n    body text not null default '',\n    status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft', 'published')),\n    is_home integer not null default 0,\n    author_id integer references accounts(id),\n    created_at text not null,\n    updated_at text not null,\n    first_published_at text\n)\n\"\"\"\n\nHOME_BODY = (\"Study Hall is every Monday, 8-10pm in Hayes 311. \"\n             \"All are welcome, and there are free snacks.\")\n\n_SELECT = (\"select posts.*, accounts.display_name as author from posts\"\n           \" join accounts on accounts.id = posts.author_id\")\n\n\nclass EmptyTitle(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A Post or Page must have a title.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass HomeProtected(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Home can never be deleted or set to Draft, by anyone.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef now() -> datetime:\n    \"\"\"The current time. Tests replace this to control dates.\"\"\"\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n\n\ndef _stamp() -> str:\n    return now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\")\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the tables, and Home if it is missing, so the site always has a front page.\"\"\"\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(SCHEMA)\n        conn.execute(PAGE_SCHEMA)\n        # A database made before Pages had an Author gets the column added.\n        if \"author_id\" not in [c[\"name\"] for c in conn.execute(\"pragma table_info(pages)\")]:\n            conn.execute(\"alter table pages add column author_id integer\"\n                         \" references accounts(id)\")\n        if not conn.execute(\"select 1 from pages where is_home = 1\").fetchone():\n            stamp = _stamp()\n            # \"index\" is the Link because Home is written to index.html.\n            conn.execute(\n                \"insert into pages (title, link, body, status, is_home, created_at,\"\n                \" updated_at, first_published_at) values ('Home', ?, ?, 'published', 1,\"\n                \" ?, ?, ?)\", (_unique_link_in(conn, \"pages\", \"index\"), HOME_BODY,\n                              stamp, stamp, stamp))\n\n\ndef eastern(stamp: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Show a stored UTC time as US Eastern, e.g. '2026-10-05 14:00'.\"\"\"\n    if not stamp:\n        return \"\"\n    when = datetime.strptime(stamp, \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    return when.astimezone(EASTERN).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M\")\n\n\ndef public_date(stamp: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Show a stored UTC time as a Visitor sees it, e.g. 'Monday, October 5, 2026'.\"\"\"\n    when = datetime.strptime(stamp, \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    when = when.astimezone(EASTERN)\n    return f\"{when:%A, %B} {when.day}, {when.year}\"\n\n\ndef _slug(title: str, fallback: str = \"post\") -> str:\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or fallback\n\n\ndef _unique_link_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, base: str) -> str:\n    link, n = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(f\"select 1 from {table} where link = ?\", (link,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        link = f\"{base}-{n}\"\n    return link\n\n\ndef _unique_link(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    return _unique_link_in(\n        conn, \"posts\", f\"{now().astimezone(EASTERN):%Y-%m-%d}-{_slug(title)}\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str, message: str = \"A Post needs a title.\") -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise EmptyTitle(message)\n    return title\n\n\ndef list_posts() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} order by posts.created_at desc, posts.id desc\"\n                            ).fetchall()\n\n\ndef published_posts() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts, latest first by first-published time. No Author is selected.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"select title, link, body, first_published_at from posts\"\n            \" where status = 'published'\"\n            \" order by first_published_at desc, id desc\").fetchall()\n\n\ndef get_post(post_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} where posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef create_post(title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Draft. Its Link is made now and never changes.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"insert into posts (title, link, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_link(conn, title), body, author_id, stamp, stamp))\n        return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef update_post(post_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Change the text of a Post. The Author and the Link stay as they were.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"update posts set title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n                           \" where id = ?\", (title, body, _stamp(), post_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef set_status(post_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Mark a Post 'published' or 'draft'. First-published time is set once.\"\"\"\n    assert status in (\"draft\", \"published\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"update posts set status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" first_published_at = case when ? = 'published' then\"\n            \" coalesce(first_published_at, ?) else first_published_at end\"\n            \" where id = ?\", (status, stamp, status, stamp, post_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef delete_post(post_id: int) -> bool:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"delete from posts where id = ?\", (post_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\n\n# --- Pages -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PAGE_SELECT = (\"select pages.*, accounts.display_name as author from pages\"\n                \" left join accounts on accounts.id = pages.author_id\")\n_PAGE_ORDER = \" order by pages.is_home desc, pages.created_at, pages.id\"\n\n\ndef list_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Every Page, Home first, then in the order they were created.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(_PAGE_SELECT + _PAGE_ORDER).fetchall()\n\n\ndef published_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages in navigation order: Home first, then by creation.\n    No Author is selected, as with published_posts.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"select * from pages where status = 'published'\"\n                            + _PAGE_ORDER.replace(\"pages.\", \"\")).fetchall()\n\n\ndef get_page(page_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(_PAGE_SELECT + \" where pages.id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef home_page() -> sqlite3.Row:\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"select * from pages where is_home = 1\").fetchone()\n\n\ndef create_page(title: str, body: str, author_id: int | None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Draft Page. Its Link is made from the title now and never changes.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title, \"A Page needs a title.\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"insert into pages (title, link, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_link_in(conn, \"pages\", _slug(title, \"page\")), body, author_id,\n             stamp, stamp))\n        return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef update_page(account, page_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Change a Page's text. Only an Admin's title is kept; an Editor changes the body.\"\"\"\n    with connect() as conn:\n        if account[\"role\"] == \"admin\":\n            title = _clean_title(title, \"A Page needs a title.\")\n            cur = conn.execute(\"update pages set title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n                               \" where id = ?\", (title, body, _stamp(), page_id))\n        else:\n            cur = conn.execute(\"update pages set body = ?, updated_at = ? where id = ?\",\n                               (body, _stamp(), page_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef set_page_status(page_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Mark a Page 'published' or 'draft'. Home cannot go back to Draft.\"\"\"\n    assert status in (\"draft\", \"published\")\n    page = get_page(page_id)\n    if page is not None and page[\"is_home\"] and status == \"draft\":\n        raise HomeProtected(\"Home cannot be set to Draft.\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"update pages set status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" first_published_at = case when ? = 'published' then\"\n            \" coalesce(first_published_at, ?) else first_published_at end\"\n            \" where id = ?\", (status, stamp, status, stamp, page_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> bool:\n    page = get_page(page_id)\n    if page is not None and page[\"is_home\"]:\n        raise HomeProtected(\"Home cannot be deleted.\")\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"delete from pages where id = ?\", (page_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef seed_demo_pages() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create About and Join & Snacks as Published Pages (Home already exists).\n\n    The Co-VP is the Author of all three. Safe to run twice: a Page that is\n    already there is left alone.\n    \"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"select id from accounts where display_name = 'Co-VP'\").fetchone()\n        author_id = row[\"id\"] if row else None\n        # Home, and any Page made before Pages had an Author, has none yet.\n        conn.execute(\"update pages set author_id = ? where author_id is null\", (author_id,))\n    demo = [(\"About\", \"AWM at Kenyon holds a weekly Study Hall. Officers: Co-VP, \"\n                      \"Co-President, Social Chair, and Treasurer.\"),\n            (\"Join & Snacks\", \"Fill out the Google Form to join or to request snacks. \"\n                              \"Add the form link here.\")]\n    for title, body in demo:\n        with connect() as conn:\n            if conn.execute(\"select 1 from pages where title = ?\", (title,)).fetchone():\n                continue\n        set_page_status(create_page(title, body, author_id), \"published\")\n\n\ndef seed_demo_posts() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create a Published and a Draft demo Post. Safe to run twice.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\"select 1 from posts\").fetchone():\n            return\n        author = conn.execute(\"select id from accounts where display_name = 'Social Chair'\"\n                              ).fetchone()\n        if author is None:\n            return\n    published = create_post(\n        \"Study Hall tonight\",\n        \"Hello everybody!\\n\\n\"\n        \"We are CURRENTLY having our study hall tonight from 8-10 in Hayes 311. \"\n        \"All are welcome and we will have lots of free snacks!\\n\\n\"\n        \"Come and say hi!\\n\\n\"\n        \"\\\\- AWM &lt;3\",\n        author[\"id\"])\n    set_status(published, \"published\")\n    create_post(\"Snack request form is open\",\n                \"Draft: Study Hall is every Monday, 8-10pm in Hayes 311, with free snacks. \"\n                \"Tell us what snacks you want. Add the form link here.\",\n                author[\"id\"])\n\"\"\"Sign-in, sign-out, and the console front door.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts, settings\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\nrouter = APIRouter()\n\nWRONG_LOGIN = \"Wrong email or password.\"\n\n\ndef login_page(request: Request, error: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/login.html\",\n        {\"title\": settings.SITE_TITLE, \"home_path\": \"/\", \"error\": error,\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/login\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef login_form(request: Request):\n    return login_page(request)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/login\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\ndef login(request: Request, email: str = Form(\"\"), password: str = Form(\"\")):\n    account = accounts.authenticate(email, password)\n    if account is None:\n        return login_page(request, WRONG_LOGIN, status_code=401)\n    accounts.sign_in(request, account)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/admin\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/logout\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_csrf)])\ndef logout(request: Request):\n    accounts.sign_out(request)\n    return RedirectResponse(\"/login\", status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/admin\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef admin_home(request: Request, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, \"admin/hello.html\",\n        {\"title\": \"Admin\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"account\": account,\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request)})\n\"\"\"Console screens for Pages: list, edit, and (Admin only) create, status, delete.\n\nAnyone signed in may list Pages, edit a Page's body, and preview. Creating,\ndeleting, and changing status go through accounts.require_admin, so an Editor\nrequesting them by direct URL gets the \"no permission\" screen.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, markdown\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n# require_account comes first so an anonymous POST is sent to sign-in, not\n# refused for a missing token. Admin-only routes check the Role before the token.\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/pages\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_account)])\ncsrf = [Depends(accounts.require_csrf)]\nadmin_only = [Depends(accounts.require_admin), *csrf]\n\nLIST_URL = \"/admin/pages\"\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = message\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, template: str, account, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, template,\n        {\"title\": \"Pages\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\", \"account\": account,\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request),\n         \"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", \"\"), **context},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef list_screen(request: Request, account, error: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200):\n    return render(request, \"admin/pages.html\", account, status_code=status_code,\n                  pages=content.list_pages(), error=error)\n\n\ndef found(page_id: int):\n    page = content.get_page(page_id)\n    if page is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n    return page\n\n\ndef form_screen(request: Request, account, page, title: str, body: str,\n                error: str = \"\", status_code: int = 200):\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_form.html\", account, status_code=status_code,\n                  page=page, form_title=title, form_body=body, error=error)\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef list_pages(request: Request, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    return list_screen(request, account)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", response_class=HTMLResponse, dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_admin)])\ndef new_page(request: Request, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    return form_screen(request, account, None, \"\", \"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=admin_only)\ndef create_page(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    try:\n        content.create_page(title, body, account[\"id\"])\n    except content.EmptyTitle as problem:\n        return form_screen(request, account, None, title, body, str(problem), 400)\n    flash(request, f\"Created Draft Page “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", response_class=HTMLResponse, dependencies=csrf)\ndef preview_page(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                 account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    \"\"\"Show the sanitized rendering of the form's text. Nothing is saved.\"\"\"\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_preview.html\", account, preview_title=title.strip(),\n                  rendered=markdown.render(body), css_path=\"/style.css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/edit\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef edit_page(request: Request, page_id: int, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    return form_screen(request, account, page, page[\"title\"], page[\"body\"])\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef save_page(request: Request, page_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n              account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    try:\n        content.update_page(account, page_id, title, body)\n    except content.EmptyTitle as problem:\n        return form_screen(request, account, page, title, body, str(problem), 400)\n    flash(request, f\"Saved “{found(page_id)['title']}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/publish\", dependencies=admin_only)\ndef publish_page(request: Request, page_id: int):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    content.set_page_status(page_id, \"published\")\n    flash(request, f\"Published “{page['title']}”. It reaches Visitors at the next Go live.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=admin_only)\ndef unpublish_page(request: Request, page_id: int, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    try:\n        content.set_page_status(page_id, \"draft\")\n    except content.HomeProtected as problem:\n        return list_screen(request, account, str(problem), 400)\n    flash(request, f\"Set “{page['title']}” back to Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{page_id}/delete\", response_class=HTMLResponse,\n            dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_admin)])\ndef confirm_delete(request: Request, page_id: int, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    if page[\"is_home\"]:\n        return list_screen(request, account, \"Home cannot be deleted.\", 400)\n    return render(request, \"admin/page_delete.html\", account, page=page)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{page_id}/delete\", dependencies=admin_only)\ndef delete_page(request: Request, page_id: int, account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    page = found(page_id)\n    try:\n        content.delete_page(page_id)\n    except content.HomeProtected as problem:\n        return list_screen(request, account, str(problem), 400)\n    flash(request, f\"Deleted “{page['title']}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\"\"\"Console screens for Posts: list, write, edit, publish, delete.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, missing token.\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_account)])\ncsrf = [Depends(accounts.require_csrf)]\n\nLIST_URL = \"/admin/posts\"\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = message\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, template: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, template,\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\",\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request),\n         \"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", \"\"), **context},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef found(post_id: int):\n    post = content.get_post(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise status_code=400, post=post, form_title=title,\n                  form_body=body, error=\"A Post needs a title.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef list_posts(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/posts.html\", posts=content.list_posts())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef new_post(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post=None, form_title=\"\",\n                  form_body=\"\", error=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef create_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    try:\n        content.create_post(title, body, account[\"id\"])\n    except content.EmptyTitle:\n        return form_error(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", None, title, body)\n    flash(request, f\"Created Draft “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", response_class=HTMLResponse, dependencies=csrf)\ndef preview_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    \"\"\"Show the sanitized rendering of the form's text. Nothing is saved.\"\"\"\n    # The local app serves the public stylesheet at /style.css.\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_preview.html\", preview_title=title.strip(),\n                  rendered=markdown.render(body), css_path=\"/style.css\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/edit\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef edit_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = found(post_id)\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post=post, form_title=post[\"title\"],\n                  form_body=post[\"body\"], error=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef save_post(request: Request, post_id: int, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    post = found(post_id)\n    try:\n        content.update_post(post_id, title, body)\n    except content.EmptyTitle:\n        return form_error(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post, title, body)\n    flash(request, f\"Saved “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/publish\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef publish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = found(post_id)\n    content.set_status(post_id, \"published\")\n    flash(request, f\"Published “{post['title']}”. It reaches Visitors at the next Go live.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/unpublish\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef unpublish_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = found(post_id)\n    content.set_status(post_id, \"draft\")\n    flash(request, f\"Set “{post['title']}” back to Draft.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.get(\"/{post_id}/delete\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef confirm_delete(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_delete.html\", post=found(post_id))\n\n\n@router.post(\"/{post_id}/delete\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef delete_post(request: Request, post_id: int):\n    post = found(post_id)\n    content.delete_post(post_id)\n {"parentUuid":"74f85dcf-2ded-46c7-9bcc-2065c4c97d09","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a2ef90f8-e40e-41d1-b2e7-1a3f6db91c2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01NSH2BGfvbFehTQMVxfRV3D","type":"tool_result","content":"\"\"\"Console screens for Posts: list, write, edit, publish, delete.\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nfrom fastapi import APIRouter, Depends, Form, HTTPException, Request\nfrom fastapi.responses import HTMLResponse, RedirectResponse\n\nfrom app import accounts, content, markdown\nfrom app.templating import templates\n\n# require_account comes first so an anonymous POST is sent to sign-in, not\n# refused for a missing token.\nrouter = APIRouter(prefix=\"/admin/posts\", dependencies=[Depends(accounts.require_account)])\ncsrf = [Depends(accounts.require_csrf)]\n\nLIST_URL = \"/admin/posts\"\n\n\ndef flash(request: Request, message: str) -> None:\n    request.session[\"flash\"] = message\n\n\ndef render(request: Request, template: str, status_code: int = 200, **context):\n    return templates.TemplateResponse(\n        request, template,\n        {\"title\": \"Posts\", \"home_path\": \"/admin\",\n         \"csrf_token\": accounts.csrf_token(request),\n         \"flash\": request.session.pop(\"flash\", \"\"), **context},\n        status_code=status_code)\n\n\ndef found(post_id: int):\n    post = content.get_post(post_id)\n    if post is None:\n        raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n    return post\n\n\ndef form_error(request: Request, template: str, post, title: str, body: str):\n    return render(request, template, status_code=400, post=post, form_title=title,\n                  form_body=body, error=\"A Post needs a title.\")\n\n\n@router.get(\"\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef list_posts(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/posts.html\", posts=content.list_posts())\n\n\n@router.get(\"/new\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\ndef new_post(request: Request):\n    return render(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", post=None, form_title=\"\",\n                  form_body=\"\", error=\"\")\n\n\n@router.post(\"\", dependencies=csrf)\ndef create_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\"),\n                account=Depends(accounts.require_account)):\n    try:\n        content.create_post(title, body, account[\"id\"])\n    except content.EmptyTitle:\n        return form_error(request, \"admin/post_form.html\", None, title, body)\n    flash(request, f\"Created Draft “{title.strip()}”.\")\n    return RedirectResponse(LIST_URL, status_code=303)\n\n\n@router.post(\"/preview\", response_class=HTMLResponse, dependencies=csrf)\ndef preview_post(request: Request, title: str = Form(\"\"), body: str = Form(\"\")):\n    \"\"\"Show {"parentUuid":"32bd693a-4161-4967-8ffa-c64c1f1f18e8","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a2ef90f8-e40e-41d1-b2e7-1a3f6db91c2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"tool_use_id":"toolu_01RCgVrp1Kptuvn6XmUwpRoU","type":"tool_result","content":"    @app.get(\"/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_page(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_page(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n        return page\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_past():\n        return publish.render_past()\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_post(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_post(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n        return page\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Content: Posts and Pages.\n\nOwns saving, status changes, Link generation, and deletion. Routes ask this\nmodule; they do not touch the database themselves. Any Editor or Admin may do\nanything to any Post, so there are no per-Post permission checks here. Pages\ndiffer: only an Admin changes a Page's title, and Home is protected for everyone.\n\nTimes are stored as UTC ISO strings and shown in US Eastern.\n\"\"\"\nfrom __future__ import annotations\n\nimport re\nimport sqlite3\nfrom datetime import datetime, timezone\nfrom zoneinfo import ZoneInfo\n\nfrom app.accounts import connect\n\nEASTERN = ZoneInfo(\"America/New_York\")\n\nSCHEMA = \"\"\"\ncreate table if not exists posts (\n    id integer primary key,\n    title text not null,\n    link text not null unique,\n    body text not null default '',\n    status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft', 'published')),\n    author_id integer not null references accounts(id),\n    created_at text not null,\n    updated_at text not null,\n    first_published_at text\n)\n\"\"\"\n\nPAGE_SCHEMA = \"\"\"\ncreate table if not exists pages (\n    id integer primary key,\n    title text not null,\n    link text not null unique,\n    body text not null default '',\n    status text not null default 'draft' check (status in ('draft', 'published')),\n    is_home integer not null default 0,\n    author_id integer references accounts(id),\n    created_at text not null,\n    updated_at text not null,\n    first_published_at text\n)\n\"\"\"\n\nHOME_BODY = (\"Study Hall is every Monday, 8-10pm in Hayes 311. \"\n             \"All are welcome, and there are free snacks.\")\n\n_SELECT = (\"select posts.*, accounts.display_name as author from posts\"\n           \" join accounts on accounts.id = posts.author_id\")\n\n\nclass EmptyTitle(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"A Post or Page must have a title.\"\"\"\n\n\nclass HomeProtected(ValueError):\n    \"\"\"Home can never be deleted or set to Draft, by anyone.\"\"\"\n\n\ndef now() -> datetime:\n    \"\"\"The current time. Tests replace this to control dates.\"\"\"\n    return datetime.now(timezone.utc)\n\n\ndef _stamp() -> str:\n    return now().strftime(\"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\")\n\n\ndef init_db() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create the tables, and Home if it is missing, so the site always has a front page.\"\"\"\n    with connect() as conn:\n        conn.execute(SCHEMA)\n        conn.execute(PAGE_SCHEMA)\n        # A database made before Pages had an Author gets the column added.\n        if \"author_id\" not in [c[\"name\"] for c in conn.execute(\"pragma table_info(pages)\")]:\n            conn.execute(\"alter table pages add column author_id integer\"\n                         \" references accounts(id)\")\n        if not conn.execute(\"select 1 from pages where is_home = 1\").fetchone():\n            stamp = _stamp()\n            # \"index\" is the Link because Home is written to index.html.\n            conn.execute(\n                \"insert into pages (title, link, body, status, is_home, created_at,\"\n                \" updated_at, first_published_at) values ('Home', ?, ?, 'published', 1,\"\n                \" ?, ?, ?)\", (_unique_link_in(conn, \"pages\", \"index\"), HOME_BODY,\n                              stamp, stamp, stamp))\n\n\ndef eastern(stamp: str | None) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Show a stored UTC time as US Eastern, e.g. '2026-10-05 14:00'.\"\"\"\n    if not stamp:\n        return \"\"\n    when = datetime.strptime(stamp, \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    return when.astimezone(EASTERN).strftime(\"%Y-%m-%d %H:%M\")\n\n\ndef public_date(stamp: str) -> str:\n    \"\"\"Show a stored UTC time as a Visitor sees it, e.g. 'Monday, October 5, 2026'.\"\"\"\n    when = datetime.strptime(stamp, \"%Y-%m-%dT%H:%M:%SZ\").replace(tzinfo=timezone.utc)\n    when = when.astimezone(EASTERN)\n    return f\"{when:%A, %B} {when.day}, {when.year}\"\n\n\ndef _slug(title: str, fallback: str = \"post\") -> str:\n    return re.sub(r\"[^a-z0-9]+\", \"-\", title.lower()).strip(\"-\") or fallback\n\n\ndef _unique_link_in(conn: sqlite3.Connection, table: str, base: str) -> str:\n    link, n = base, 1\n    while conn.execute(f\"select 1 from {table} where link = ?\", (link,)).fetchone():\n        n += 1\n        link = f\"{base}-{n}\"\n    return link\n\n\ndef _unique_link(conn: sqlite3.Connection, title: str) -> str:\n    return _unique_link_in(\n        conn, \"posts\", f\"{now().astimezone(EASTERN):%Y-%m-%d}-{_slug(title)}\")\n\n\ndef _clean_title(title: str, message: str = \"A Post needs a title.\") -> str:\n    title = title.strip()\n    if not title:\n        raise EmptyTitle(message)\n    return title\n\n\ndef list_posts() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} order by posts.created_at desc, posts.id desc\"\n                            ).fetchall()\n\n\ndef published_posts() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Published Posts, latest first by first-published time. No Author is selected.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\n            \"select title, link, body, first_published_at from posts\"\n            \" where status = 'published'\"\n            \" order by first_published_at desc, id desc\").fetchall()\n\n\ndef get_post(post_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(f\"{_SELECT} where posts.id = ?\", (post_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef create_post(title: str, body: str, author_id: int) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Draft. Its Link is made now and never changes.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"insert into posts (title, link, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_link(conn, title), body, author_id, stamp, stamp))\n        return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef update_post(post_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Change the text of a Post. The Author and the Link stay as they were.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title)\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\"update posts set title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n                           \" where id = ?\", (title, body, _stamp(), post_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef set_status(post_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Mark a Post 'published' or 'draft'. First-published time is set once.\"\"\"\n    assert status in (\"draft\", \"published\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"update posts set status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" first_published_at = case when ? = 'published' then\"\n            \" coalesce(first_published_at, ?) else first_published_at end\"\n            \" where id = ?\", (status, stamp, status, stamp, post_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef delete_post(post_id: int) -> bool:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"delete from posts where id = ?\", (post_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\n\n# --- Pages -----------------------------------------------------------------\n\n_PAGE_SELECT = (\"select pages.*, accounts.display_name as author from pages\"\n                \" left join accounts on accounts.id = pages.author_id\")\n_PAGE_ORDER = \" order by pages.is_home desc, pages.created_at, pages.id\"\n\n\ndef list_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Every Page, Home first, then in the order they were created.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(_PAGE_SELECT + _PAGE_ORDER).fetchall()\n\n\ndef published_pages() -> list[sqlite3.Row]:\n    \"\"\"Published Pages in navigation order: Home first, then by creation.\n    No Author is selected, as with published_posts.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"select * from pages where status = 'published'\"\n                            + _PAGE_ORDER.replace(\"pages.\", \"\")).fetchall()\n\n\ndef get_page(page_id: int) -> sqlite3.Row | None:\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(_PAGE_SELECT + \" where pages.id = ?\", (page_id,)).fetchone()\n\n\ndef home_page() -> sqlite3.Row:\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"select * from pages where is_home = 1\").fetchone()\n\n\ndef create_page(title: str, body: str, author_id: int | None) -> int:\n    \"\"\"Save a new Draft Page. Its Link is made from the title now and never changes.\"\"\"\n    title = _clean_title(title, \"A Page needs a title.\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"insert into pages (title, link, body, author_id, created_at, updated_at)\"\n            \" values (?, ?, ?, ?, ?, ?)\",\n            (title, _unique_link_in(conn, \"pages\", _slug(title, \"page\")), body, author_id,\n             stamp, stamp))\n        return cur.lastrowid\n\n\ndef update_page(account, page_id: int, title: str, body: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Change a Page's text. Only an Admin's title is kept; an Editor changes the body.\"\"\"\n    with connect() as conn:\n        if account[\"role\"] == \"admin\":\n            title = _clean_title(title, \"A Page needs a title.\")\n            cur = conn.execute(\"update pages set title = ?, body = ?, updated_at = ?\"\n                               \" where id = ?\", (title, body, _stamp(), page_id))\n        else:\n            cur = conn.execute(\"update pages set body = ?, updated_at = ? where id = ?\",\n                               (body, _stamp(), page_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef set_page_status(page_id: int, status: str) -> bool:\n    \"\"\"Mark a Page 'published' or 'draft'. Home cannot go back to Draft.\"\"\"\n    assert status in (\"draft\", \"published\")\n    page = get_page(page_id)\n    if page is not None and page[\"is_home\"] and status == \"draft\":\n        raise HomeProtected(\"Home cannot be set to Draft.\")\n    stamp = _stamp()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        cur = conn.execute(\n            \"update pages set status = ?, updated_at = ?,\"\n            \" first_published_at = case when ? = 'published' then\"\n            \" coalesce(first_published_at, ?) else first_published_at end\"\n            \" where id = ?\", (status, stamp, status, stamp, page_id))\n        return cur.rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef delete_page(page_id: int) -> bool:\n    page = get_page(page_id)\n    if page is not None and page[\"is_home\"]:\n        raise HomeProtected(\"Home cannot be deleted.\")\n    with connect() as conn:\n        return conn.execute(\"delete from pages where id = ?\", (page_id,)).rowcount == 1\n\n\ndef seed_demo_pages() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create About and Join & Snacks as Published Pages (Home already exists).\n\n    The Co-VP is the Author of all three. Safe to run twice: a Page that is\n    already there is left alone.\n    \"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        row = conn.execute(\"select id from accounts where display_name = 'Co-VP'\").fetchone()\n        author_id = row[\"id\"] if row else None\n        # Home, and any Page made before Pages had an Author, has none yet.\n        conn.execute(\"update pages set author_id = ? where author_id is null\", (author_id,))\n    demo = [(\"About\", \"AWM at Kenyon holds a weekly Study Hall. Officers: Co-VP, \"\n                      \"Co-President, Social Chair, and Treasurer.\"),\n            (\"Join & Snacks\", \"Fill out the Google Form to join or to request snacks. \"\n                              \"Add the form link here.\")]\n    for title, body in demo:\n        with connect() as conn:\n            if conn.execute(\"select 1 from pages where title = ?\", (title,)).fetchone():\n                continue\n        set_page_status(create_page(title, body, author_id), \"published\")\n\n\ndef seed_demo_posts() -> None:\n    \"\"\"Create a Published and a Draft demo Post. Safe to run twice.\"\"\"\n    init_db()\n    with connect() as conn:\n        if conn.execute(\"select 1 from posts\").fetchone():\n            return\n        author = conn.execute(\"select id from accounts where display_name = 'Social Chair'\"\n                              ).fetchone()\n        if author is None:\n            return\n    published = create_post(\n        \"Study Hall tonight\",\n        \"Hello everybody!\\n\\n\"\n        \"We are CURRENTLY having our study hall tonight from 8-10 in Hayes 311. \"\n        \"All are welcome and we will have lots of free snacks!\\n\\n\"\n        \"Come and say hi!\\n\\n\"\n        \"\\\\- AWM &lt;3\",\n        author[\"id\"])\n    set_status(published, \"published\")\n    create_post(\"Snack request form is open\",\n                \"Draft: Study Hall is every Monday, 8-10pm in Hayes 311, with free snacks. \"\n                \"Tell us what snacks you want. Add the form link here.\",\n                author[\"id\"])","is_error":false}]},"uuid":"822d0596-93d8-463b-862b-831f1fe9f051","timestamp":"2026-10-02T17:38:03.445Z","toolUseResult":{"stdout":"    @app.get(\"/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_page(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_page(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Page.\")\n        return page\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/index.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_past():\n        return publish.render_past()\n\n    @app.get(\"/posts/{link}.html\", response_class=HTMLResponse)\n    def public_post(link: str):\n        page = publish.render_post(link)\n        if page is None:\n            raise HTTPException(status_code=404, detail=\"No such Post.\")\n        return page\n\n    # Your ticket work plugs in here, e.g.\n    #   from app.routes import posts\n    #   app.include_router(posts.router)\n    return app\n\n\napp = create_app()\n\"\"\"Content: Posts and Pages.\n\nOwns saving, status changes, Link generation, and deletion.  token = csrf_token(c, f\"{LIST}/new\")\n    return c.post(LIST, data={\"title\": title, \"body\": body, \"csrf_token\": token},\n                  follow_redirects=False)\n\n\ndef post_ids(c):\n    return [int(i) for i in re.findall(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", c.get(LIST).text)]\n\n\ndef newest_id(c):\n    return max(post_ids(c))\n\n\ndef edit(c, post_id, **fields):\n    token = csrf_token(c,  return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/unpublish\", f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/edit\")\n\n\ndef delete_page(c, page_id):\n    return post_page(c, f\"{PAGES}/{page_id}/delete\", re.sub(r\"<[^>]+>\", \" \", row)).strip()\n            for row in re.findall(r\"<tr>.*?</tr>\", body.group(1), re.DOTALL)]\n\n\ndef titles(html):\n    return re.findall(r'<a run_seed()\n    return client_as(\"editor\")\n\n\n# --- dashboard ------------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_dashboard_shows_counts_of_draft_posts_published_posts_and_pages(client_as):\n    run_seed()\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    drafts, published, pages = counts(c)\n    assert (drafts, published, pages) == (1, 1, 3)\n\n\ndef test_counts_follow_a_post_created_published_unpublished_and_deleted(client_as):\n    run_seed()\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    before = counts(c)\n\n    create(c, title=\"Counting Post\")\n    post_id = newest_id(c)\n    assert counts(c) == (before[0] + 1, before[1], before[2])\n\n    act(c, post_id, \"publish\")\n    assert counts(c) == (before[0], before[1] + 1, before[2])\n\n    act(c, post_id, \"unpublish\")\n    assert counts(c) == (before[0] + 1, before[1], before[2])\n\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\")\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\", data={\"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert counts(c) == before\n\n\ndef test_pages_count_grows_with_a_new_page_whether_draft_or_published(client_as):\n    c = response.headers[\"location\"] == \"/login\"\n\n\n# --- content list ---------------------------------------------------------\n\ndef test_content_list_shows_posts_and_pages_together_with_their_details(seeded):\n    html = seeded.get(CONTENT).text\n    shown = rows_of(html)\n    assert len(shown) == 5\n    assert any(\"Study Hall test_each_row_links_to_that_items_editor(seeded):\n    html = seeded.get(CONTENT).text\n    for kind in (\"posts\", \"pages\"):\n        links = re.findall(rf'href=\"(/admin/{kind}/\\d+/edit)\"', old = [i for i in re.findall(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", c.get(\"/admin/posts\").text)\n           if int(i) != newest_id(c)][0]\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"/admin/posts/{old}/edit\")\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{old}\", data={\"title\": \"Edited later\", \"body\": \"x\",\n                                         \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert titles(c.get(CONTENT).text)[0] == test_unknown_filter_values_are_ignored(seeded):\n    response = seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=bogus&type=nonsense\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert len(rows_of(response.text)) == assert \"<script>alert(1)</script>\" not in html\n    assert \"&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;\" in html\n\n\ndef test_publishing_a_page_shows_up_in_the_filtered_list(client_as):\n    c = shown)\n    assert any(\"About\" in r and \"Page\" in r and \"Co-VP\" in r for r in shown)\n    assert re.search(r\"\\d{4}-\\d{2}-\\d{2} \\d{2}:\\d{2}\", shown[0]), \"last-updated time\"\n\n\ndef test_each_row_links_to_that_items_editor(seeded):\n    html = seeded.get(CONTENT).text\n    for kind in (\"posts\", \"pages\"):\n        links = re.findall(rf'href=\"(/admin/{kind}/\\d+/edit)\"', html)\n        assert links, f\"expected {kind} rows to link to their editors\"\n        assert seeded.get(links[0]).status_code == 200\n\n\ndef test_list_is_most_recently_updated_first(client_as):\n    run_seed()\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    create(c, title=\"Zebra newest\")\n    assert titles(c.get(CONTENT).text)[0] == \"Zebra newest\"\n    # Editing an older Post moves it to the top.\n    old = [i for i in re.findall(r\"/admin/posts/(\\d+)/edit\", c.get(\"/admin/posts\").text)\n           if int(i) != newest_id(c)][0]\n    token = csrf_token(c, f\"/admin/posts/{old}/edit\")\n    c.post(f\"/admin/posts/{old}\", data={\"title\": \"Edited later\", \"body\": \"x\",\n                                         \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert titles(c.get(CONTENT).text)[0] == \"Edited later\"\n\n\ndef test_filter_by_status(seeded):\n    drafts = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft\").text)\n    assert drafts and all(\"Draft\" in r for r in drafts)\n    published = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=published\").text)\n    assert published and all(\"Published\" in r for r in published)\n    assert len(drafts) + len(published) == 5\n\n\ndef test_filter_by_type(seeded):\n    posts = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?type=post\").text)\n    assert len(posts) == 2 and all(\"/ Page\" not in r and \" Page \" not in f\" {r} \"\n                                   for r in posts)\n    pages = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?type=page\").text)\n    assert len(pages) == 3\n\n\ndef test_filters_combine(seeded):\n    rows = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft&type=post\").text)\n    assert len(rows) == 1 and \"Snack request form is open\" in rows[0]\n    rows = rows_of(seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=published&type=page\").text)\n    assert len(rows) == 3\n\n\ndef test_a_filter_that_matches_nothing_says_so_with_200(seeded):\n    response = seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft&type=page\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert \"nothing here\" in response.text.lower()\n    assert \"<tbody>\" not in response.text\n\n\ndef test_unknown_filter_values_are_ignored(seeded):\n    response = seeded.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=bogus&type=nonsense\")\n    assert response.status_code == 200\n    assert len(rows_of(response.text)) == 5\n\n\ndef test_script_in_a_title_is_shown_as_text_in_the_list(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    create(c, title=\"<script>alert(1)</script>\")\n    html = c.get(CONTENT).text\n    assert \"<script>alert(1)</script>\" not in html\n    assert \"&lt;script&gt;alert(1)&lt;/script&gt;\" in html\n\n\ndef test_publishing_a_page_shows_up_in_the_filtered_list(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    new_page(c, title=\"Meetings\")\n    assert any(\"Meetings\" in r for r in rows_of(c.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=draft\").text))\n    page_id = int(re.search(r'/admin/pages/(\\d+)/edit\">Meetings',\n                            c.get(CONTENT).text).group(1))\n    publish_page(c, page_id)\n    assert any(\"Meetings\" in r for r in rows_of(c.get(f\"{CONTENT}?status=published\").text))\n\n\n# --- navigation on every console screen -----------------------------------\n\ndef console_nav(html):\n    nav = re.search(r\"<nav.*?</nav>\", html, re.DOTALL)\n    assert nav, \"every console screen needs a <nav>\"\n    return nav.group(0)\n\n\ndef assert_has_console_nav(html, position):\n    nav = console_nav(html)\n    for href in (\"/admin\", CONTENT, \"/admin/posts/new\"):\n        assert f'href=\"{href}\"' in nav, f\"nav should link to {href}\"\n    assert \"/logout\" in nav and \"Sign out\" in nav\n    assert position in nav\n\n\ndef test_every_console_screen_has_the_same_navigation_and_viewport_tag(client_as):\n    run_seed()\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    post_id = newest_id(c)\n    page_id = int(re.search(r\"/admin/pages/(\\d+)/edit\", c.get(\"/admin/pages\").text).group(1))\n    screens = [DASHBOARD, CONTENT, \"/admin/posts\", \"/admin/posts/new\",\n               f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/edit\", f\"/admin/posts/{post_id}/delete\",\n               \"/admin/pages\", f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/edit\"]\n    for path in screens:\n        response = c.get(path)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, path\n        assert_has_console_nav(response.text, \"Social Chair\")\n        assert 'name=\"viewport\"' in response.text and \"width=device-width\" in response.text\n\n\ndef test_admin_only_screens_and_confirmations_have_the_navigation(client_as):\n    run_seed()\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    new_page(c, title=\"Meetings\")\n    page_id = int(re.search(r'/admin/pages/(\\d+)/edit\">Meetings',\n                            c.get(CONTENT).text).group(1))\n    for path in (\"/admin/pages/new\", f\"/admin/pages/{page_id}/delete\"):\n        response = c.get(path)\n        assert response.status_code == 200, path\n        assert_has_console_nav(response.text, \"Co-VP\")\n\n\ndef test_no_permission_and_preview_screens_have_the_navigation(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"editor\")\n    refused = c.get(\"/admin/pages/new\")\n    assert refused.status_code == 403\n    assert_has_console_nav(refused.text, \"Social Chair\")\n\n    token = csrf_token(c, \"/admin/posts/new\")\n    preview = c.post(\"/admin/posts/preview\",\n                     data={\"title\": \"T\", \"body\": \"hi\", \"csrf_token\": token})\n    assert_has_console_nav(preview.text, \"Social Chair\")\n\n\ndef test_sign_in_screen_has_no_console_navigation(client):\n    html = client.get(\"/login\").text\n    assert \"/admin/content\" not in html\n\n\ndef test_signing_out_from_the_navigation_works(client_as):\n    c = client_as(\"admin\")\n    html = c.get(DASHBOARD).text\n    token = re.search(r'name=\"csrf_token\"\\s+value=\"([^\"]+)\"', console_nav(html)).group(1)\n    response = c.post(\"/logout\", data={\"csrf_token\": token}, follow_redirects=False)\n    assert response.status_code in (302, 303)\n    assert c.get(DASHBOARD, follow_redirects=False).status_code in (302, 303)\n\n\ndef test_the_local_public_preview_has_no_console_navigation(client_as):\n {"parentUuid":"40c6565f-4a91-47b7-a942-f22ff123d9f9","isSidechain":false,"promptId":"a2ef90f8-e40e-41d1-b2e7-1a3f6db91c2c","type":"user","message":{"role":"user","content":[{"type":"text","text":"Base directory for this skill: /home/msgre/.claude/plugins/cache/claude-plugins-official/mattpocock-skills/1.2.3/skills/engineering/code-review\n\nTwo-axis review of the diff between `HEAD` and a fixed point the user supplies:\n\n- **Standards**: does the code conform to this repo's documented coding standards?\n- **Spec**: does the code faithfully implement the originating issue / spec?\n\nBoth axes run as **parallel sub-agents** so they don't pollute each other's context, then this skill aggregates their findings.\n\nThe issue tracker should have been provided to you. If `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md` is missing, tell the user to run `/setup-matt-pocock-skills`.\n\n## Process\n\n### 1. Pin the fixed point\n\nWhatever the user said is the fixed point (a commit SHA, branch name, tag, `main`, `HEAD~5`, etc.). If they didn't specify one, ask for it.\n\nCapture the diff command once: `git diff <fixed-point>...HEAD` (three-dot, so the comparison is against the merge-base). Also note the list of commits via `git log <fixed-point>..HEAD --oneline`.\n\nBefore going further, confirm the fixed point resolves (`git rev-parse <fixed-point>`) and the diff is non-empty. A bad ref or empty diff should fail here, not inside two parallel sub-agents.\n\n### 2. Identify the spec source\n\nLook for the originating spec, in this order:\n\n1. Issue references in the commit messages (`#123`, `Closes #45`, GitLab `!67`, etc.), fetched via the workflow in `docs/agents/issue-tracker.md`.\n2. A path the user passed as an argument.\n3. A spec file under `docs/`, `specs/`, or `.scratch/` matching the branch name or feature.\n4. If nothing is found, ask the user where the spec is. If they say there isn't one, the **Spec** sub-agent will skip and report \"no spec available\".\n\n### 3. Identify the standards sources\n\nAnything in the repo that documents how code should be written, such as `CODING_STANDARDS.md` or `CONTRIBUTING.md`.\n\nOn top of whatever the repo documents, the Standards axis always carries the **smell baseline** below: a fixed set of Fowler code smells (_Refactoring_, ch.3) that applies even when a repo documents nothing. Two rules bind it:\n\n- **The repo overrides.** A documented repo standard always wins; where it endorses something the baseline would flag, suppress the smell.\n- **Always a judgement call.** Each smell is a labelled heuristic (\"possible Feature Envy\"), never a hard violation. Like any standard here, skip anything tooling already enforces.\n\nEach smell reads *what it is* → *how to fix*; match it against the diff:\n\n- **Mysterious Name**: a function, variable, or type whose name doesn't reveal what it does or holds. → rename it; if no honest name comes, the design's murky.\n- **Duplicated Code**: the same logic shape appears in more than one hunk or file in the change. → extract the shared shape, call it from both.\n- **Feature Envy**: a method that reaches into another object's data more than its own. → move the method onto the data it envies.\n- **Data Clumps**: the same few fields or params keep travelling together (a type wanting to be born). → bundle them into one type, pass that.\n- **Primitive Obsession**: a primitive or string standing in for a domain concept that deserves its own type. → give the concept its own small type.\n- **Repeated Switches**: the same `switch`/`if`-cascade on the same type recurs across the change. → replace with polymorphism, or one map both sites share.\n- **Shotgun Surgery**: one logical change forces scattered edits across many files in the diff. → gather what changes together into one module.\n- **Divergent Change**: one file or module is edited for several unrelated reasons. → split so each module changes for one reason.\n- **Speculative Generality**: abstraction, parameters, or hooks added for needs the spec doesn't have. → delete it; inline back until a real need shows.\n- **Message Chains**: long `a.b().c().d()` navigation the caller shouldn't depend on. → hide the walk behind one method on the first object.\n- **Middle Man**: a class or function that mostly just delegates onward. → cut it, call the real target direct.\n- **Refused Bequest**: a subclass or implementer that ignores or overrides most of what it inherits. → drop the inheritance, use composition.\n\n### 4. Spawn both sub-agents in parallel\n\n**Standards sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The full diff command and commit list.\n- The list of standards-source files you found in step 3, **plus the smell baseline from step 3** pasted in full (the sub-agent has no other access to it).\n- The brief: \"Report, per file/hunk where relevant, (a) every place the diff violates a documented standard: cite the standard (file + the rule); and (b) any baseline smell you spot: name it and quote the hunk. Distinguish hard violations from judgement calls: documented-standard breaches can be hard, but baseline smells are always judgement calls, and a documented repo standard overrides the baseline. Skip anything tooling enforces. Under 400 words.\"\n\n**Spec sub-agent prompt** should include:\n\n- The diff command and commit list.\n- The path or fetched contents of the spec.\n- The brief: \"Report: (a) requirements the spec asked for that are missing or partial; (b) behaviour in the diff that wasn't asked for (scope creep); (c) requirements that look implemented but where the implementation looks wrong. Quote the spec line for each finding. Under 400 words.\"\n\nIf the spec is missing, skip the Spec sub-agent and note this in the final report.\n\n### 5. Aggregate\n\nPresent the two reports under `## Standards` and `## Spec` headings, verbatim or lightly cleaned. Do **not** merge or rerank findings, because the two axes are deliberately separate (see _Why two axes_).\n\nEnd with a one-line summary: total findings per axis, and the worst issue _within each axis_ (if any). Don't pick a single winner across axes: that's the reranking the separation exists to prevent.\n\n## Why two axes\n\nA change can pass one axis and fail the other:\n\n- Code that follows every standard but implements the wrong thing → **Standards pass, Spec fail.**\n- Code that does exactly what the issue asked but breaks the project's conventions → **Spec pass, Standards fail.**\n\nReporting them separately stops one axis from masking the other.\n\n\nARGUMENTS: since HEAD; ticket #6 (T05), spec #1"}]},"isMeta":true,"turnCompanion":true,"uuid":"a972acba-89cc-4664-ac35-0333c630ac11","timestamp":"2026-10-02T17:42:55.584Z","sourceToolUseID":"toolu_013EdTcqqoaWLns4oe4UHc8F","session_id":"0e072829-2198-4f36-9e52-e2c9d68d4154","userType":"external","entrypoint":"cli","cwd":"/home/msgre/code/iphs400-mp2-cms","sessionId":"e76cfbbe-5e99-48ab-9d02-948d9f541c74","version":"2.1.287","gitBranch":"main"}

{"parentUuid":"86dc0e11-dbe3-4c28-8385-f9a12fd595c8","isSidechain":false,"message":{"model":"claude-sonnet-5-5","id":"msg_011CfdpqEgav2XXqexjcTLbD","type":"message","role":"assistant","content":[{"type":"text","text":"T05 (issue #6) is built and committed as `8b12d7b`. All 171 tests pass.\n\n- **Dashboard:** `/admin` now shows Draft Posts, Published Posts and Pages counts. It also links to the Posts and Pages lists, because the old T00 page was the only way to reach Pages.\n- **Content list:** `/admin/content` lists Posts and Pages together, most recently updated first. Each row shows title, type, status, Author and last-updated time, and links to that item's editor. The filters are in the address, for example `?status=draft&type=post`. A filter with no matches shows a \"nothing here\" message and returns 200. Unknown filter values are ignored.\n- **Navigation:** every console screen has the same navigation. It links to the dashboard, the content list and a new Post, and shows the Position's name and a sign-out button. Console screens include the editors, confirmation screens, the 403 screen and the preview. The sign-in screen and the public preview don't have it.\n- **Old tests and files:** I changed the T00 test so a signed-in Officer is expected to see the dashboard, as the spec says. I deleted `templates/admin/hello.html` and updated the README line that mentioned it.\n- **Code review:** I ran `/code-review` myself rather than through two sub-agents, because the system rules I'm under say not to spawn agents unless you ask. It found one thing to fix, an over-complicated filter in `list_items`, and I simplified it. I posted the findings on issue #6 before committing.\n- **Not done:** the ticket says the 390 px no-sideways-scroll rule is checked from screenshots, and I haven't taken any.
